request.action_description: Hit reaction: she is struck, flinches backward with the head snapped back and arms thrown out, then recovers to the stance. TRUE FRONT VIEW every frame: she faces the camera, chest and face toward the viewer; forward movement and attacks go DOWN the screen toward the camera; she never turns sideways or away. Same character in every frame exactly as the reference image: petite adult woman, pale blonde long ponytail with a blue ribbon, red bikini top, red pleated mini skirt, brown belt with a purple pouch, brown gloves, brown thigh-high boots with silver knee guards, a long thin silver sewing needle held in EACH hand like a rapier. Same face, same proportions and same size as the reference; feet stay on the same ground line. Bold outline, clean pixels. No effects, no trails, no glow on the body.
